text: I feel a sense of curiosity and intellectual vigor here. The space is modern, almost clinical, yet filled with vibrant displays dedicated to research and development. The striking design and emphasis on innovation awaken my philosophical mind, nudging me to ponder the nature of progress—how each idea builds upon another, how spaces like these serve as crucibles for thought. I feel inspired but also slightly aware of the distance between the sterile environment and the lived realities of creation.
